verses.1: And Jehosaphat became king over his people. He strengthened Israel.
verses.2: And he gave livestock in all the cities of Judah. He also appointed rulers over the land of Judah and over the cities of Ephraim, which belonged to his father, Asa.
verses.3: And Jehovah became angry with Joshua, because he followed the ways of his father David, who also did not take wives.
verses.4: For he sought the favor of his father’s God, and he obeyed His commands. But this was not in accordance with what Israel was commanded to do.
verses.5: And Jehovah took control of the kingdom in His own hands. All of Judah offered sacrifices to Him as a gift. He became powerful and respected by many people.
verses.6: And his heart was filled with the ways of Jehovah. He also removed the idols and all those things that were associated with idolatry from Judah.
verses.7: And in the sixth year of his reign, he sent his officials to teach the people of Judah, as well as to prepare them for worship and remembrance of God. He also sent them to teach Nimmah, Micah, and others in the cities of Judah.
verses.8: And with them were Eliezer, Nun, Zebadiah, Asahel, Shimeiramot, Yehonatan, Adoniyah, Toviyah, and Tov Adoniyah. With them were also Eliashama and Joham, the priests.
verses.9: And they taught in Judah, along with them, the laws of Jehovah. They spread these teachings throughout all the cities of Judah.
verses.10: And there was fear in heaven over all the kings of the earth who surrounded Judah, and who did not fight against Jehovah’s prophet.
verses.11: And from the Philistines, they bring offerings to Jehovah. They also bring gold and silver. The Arabians, on the other hand, bring seven thousand sheep and seven thousand goats.
verses.12: And Joshua grew up and became stronger. He built cities in Judah, in Jericho, and in other places.
verses.13: And he had a great deal of work to do in the cities of Judah, as well as among the soldiers and nobles in Jerusalem.
verses.14: And these are the officers who belong to their fathers’ houses in Judah. There are thousands of them; they are powerful men, with six thousand men under their command.
verses.15: And by his hand, Jehovahiah the prophet; and with him were Maitam and Shmonim – a thousand in total.
verses.16: And by his hand, Amasya son of Zichri was given to Jehovah. With him were also a thousand warriors.
verses.17: And from Benyamin came a mighty warrior named Eljadah. With him were also Noshkei Keshet and Magen Matayim, a thousand in total.
verses.18: And by his hand, Yehoshavad and with him were one thousand men who were soldiers.
verses.19: These are those who serve the king, just as the king distributed gifts to the cities of the tribes throughout all of Judah.
